record.issue_text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:44 calls Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({}) synchronously inside a per-URL retrieval job, blocking one embed request on fetching and importing an entire feed

adjudication.rationale: Yes. In lib/topic_retriever.rb `perform_retrieve` unconditionally does `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true. `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` performs synchronous network I/O (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`) and iterates/imports *all* feed items. This happens in the per-URL retrieval path (triggered by `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` for a single `embed_url`), so a single embed retrieval can block a Sidekiq worker on fetching/parsing/importing an entire feed, potentially redundantly and with high latency.
